WAVE 27 -- the 85 `REJECTED_BY_v0.3` seed attempts

⚠ WHAT THE CLASS MEANS: v0.3's generator rerolled that SEED ATTEMPT away.
   It does NOT mean v0.3 was handed this v0.2 record and refused it -- the
   two emissions build different cases from the same seed, which is what
   the 1,152 SAME_SEED_DIFFERENT_RECORD cases demonstrate.

THE CONTROL that refuted the `final.flags` reading -- `final.flags` in the
archived v0.2 records, BY CLASS.  If absence were the discriminator the
three rows would differ.  They do not:
  REJECTED_BY_v0.3             n=   85  flags ABSENT=85
  SAME_SEED_DIFFERENT_RECORD   n= 1152  flags ABSENT=1152
  SHIFTED                      n= 5890  flags ABSENT=5890

=> absence of `final.flags` is NOT a discriminator (`final.regs` is sparse
   in this schema and these pin-event forms do not list it).  The reading
   that the 85 are store-stub final-PSW capture failures is WITHDRAWN.
